I am a PhD student in mathematics at KU Leuven (Belgium), working in the [Classical Analysis](https://wis.kuleuven.be/analyse) group. My supervisors are [Aron Wennman](https://sites.google.com/view/aronwennman) and [Benjamin Eichinger](https://benjamineichinger.eu/). Since November 2025, I am a FWO PhD fellow in fundamental research.

My research lies in Complex Analysis, focusing particularly on the asymptotic properties of extremal polynomials, including Chebyshev and orthogonal polynomials. I am also interested in charged particle systems such as Coloumb gases.

My master's thesis has been awarded the [Studienpreis](https://www.oemg.ac.at/Preise.html) of the Austrian Mathematical Society (ÖMG).
